# Framerate

> The fastest way to go from a text prompt to a live, production-ready 3D website. Turn ideas into stunning 3D websites instantly. Design, animate, and launch with our 3D scroll library and AI in a seamless workflow.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://framerate.space/) - The main landing page for Framerate, featuring our AI 3D website builder.
- [Pricing](https://framerate.space/pricing) - Simple, transparent pricing for our AI tools.
- [Blog](https://framerate.space/blog) - Updates, tutorials, and insights on building 3D websites.
